memo_delta.stage_one_comment: The frozen July 3 Emaar decision was Starter Position Only, but that run was superseded by the July 10 Watchlist analysis and must not be treated as a live entry recommendation. The October 6 close was below its AED12.20 anchor. H1 revenue conversion improved, while the reproduced standalone Q2 EPS of AED0.42 fell below the recorded confirmation and falsification thresholds; verify the issuer interim PDF before relying on that provisional outcome. No primary Sukuk redemption notice or Emaar Misr H1 profit result was obtained, so those elapsed tests remain not assessable. The masterplan announcement still does not supply annual capex or funding gates. Keep watching under the standing Watchlist decision. The original loss-free bear scenario and misapplied owner cap were decision-time process defects, not lessons invented from the later price decline.
